title: Everruns — the log is the session, the lease is the lock

nodes.label: Apps, UI, channels
nodes.excerpt: Agent keys reach one agent's sessions: create sessions, stream replies, answer questions, approve tools.

links.label: agent-api.md:7 — one agent exposed to your own code, key scoped to its channel

nodes.label: Control plane (server)
nodes.excerpt: Owns auth, the REST API, SSE streams and all state; workers reach data only through its gRPC service.

links.label: physical-architecture.md:25 — workers never talk to PostgreSQL directly

nodes.label: Actor index + leases
nodes.excerpt: One row per session: runnable_since, inbox cursor, lease holder, fence and expiry.

links.label: session_actors/mod.rs:1 — leasing locks rows FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED; every lease raises the fence

nodes.label: Session event log
nodes.excerpt: Every message, model response, tool call and result, sequenced per session; a trigger enforces append-only.

links.label: baseline.sql:1521 — the events table: sequence, event_type, data JSONB, context
events/mod.rs:56 — turn.started and the event-type constants

nodes.label: Worker pool (stateless)
nodes.excerpt: Workers lease runnable sessions and run whole turns; no database credentials, no durable local state.

links.label: actor_runtime/mod.rs:1 — lease runnable sessions, run each whole turn, the log is the only turn state

nodes.label: Turn fold + resume rules
nodes.excerpt: Folds the tail from the latest turn.started; unfinished calls rerun only when their tool declares it safe.

links.label: turn_resume.rs:1 — an open turn is resumed from the log alone

nodes.label: Turn loop: reason / act
nodes.excerpt: Reason, then act in parallel, then reason again — capped at 500 iterations by default.

links.label: turn.rs:1 — the turn planner is pure and deterministic; the host performs its effects

nodes.label: Tool approval gate
nodes.excerpt: Declared-risky calls park the turn and release the lease until a person answers; an allow binds the exact arguments.

links.label: tool_approval.rs:1 — the gate classifies calls by the risk the tool declares
tool_approvals.rs:1 — what was approved is read back from the emitted event

nodes.label: LLM providers
nodes.excerpt: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Bedrock and more behind one driver layer; each response is journaled as llm.generation.

links.label: events/mod.rs:91 — LLM_GENERATION, the persisted record of a model call

nodes.label: Tools + capabilities
nodes.excerpt: Files, shell, sandboxes, web, sub-agents and MCP; tools declare their side-effect class and risk hints.

links.label: tool-approval.md — modes read tool declarations, never name guesses

nodes.label: MCP catalog search
nodes.excerpt: Catalogs paged in full (up to 10,000 tools per server), searched, and revealed within 32 tools / 64 KiB by default.

links.label: tool_search.rs:443 — bounded defaults: 32 active tools, 65,536 active bytes

nodes.label: Background durable queue
nodes.excerpt: Retries, schedules and the dead letter queue for background work — agent turns no longer run here.
